rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the left side and for a leftward turn or bend, as in 左轉 or 左彎.

example.english: This arrow points to the left.
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 zin3 zi2 zyu6 zo2 bin1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is on the left side.

example.english: The car is parked on the left of our house.
example.traditional: 架車停咗喺我哋屋企左邊。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 ting4 zo2 hai2 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 zo2 bin1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the left side or direction.

example.english: The switch is on the left.

rows.note: Use this for movement or leaning towards the left, including a political context when the context makes that clear.

example.english: At the junction up ahead, turn left and you'll reach the MTR station.
example.traditional: 去到前面個路口，向左轉就係地鐵站。
example.jyutping: heoi3 dou3 cin4 min6 go3 lou6 hau2 hoeng3 zo2 zyun3 zau6 hai6 dei6 tit3 zaam6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the left hand or fist, rather than a general direction.

example.english: I write with my left hand.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 zo2 sau2 se2 zi6

rows.note: Use this for left-wing political parties or people as a group.

example.english: The left won several more seats this time.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zo2 paai3 jeng4 do1 zo2 gei2 zik6

rows.note: Use this for political beliefs, groups, or positions that are left-wing or left-leaning.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zing3 dong2 bei2 gaau3 zo2 king1
